summary: Human Resources Specialist with over 9 years of experience in recruitment, federal employment processes, and program management. Skilled in advisory services, strategic planning, policy development, onboarding, and performance management.
tools: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook)

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Provided HR advisory services to mid‑level and senior managers in the Office of Inspector General.
Served as subject matter expert on hiring authorities and delegated examining within the Talent and Acquisitions team.
Consulted on Pathways programs (Internships, Recent Graduates, Presidential Management Fellows).
Advised on staffing, recruitment, classifications, position management, and special emphasis programs.
Reviewed and prepared case files for delegated examining audits.
Revised position descriptions and created job announcements.
Led development of onboarding, training, leadership, and social media recruitment programs.
Authored agency‑wide hiring guide and presented to executive committees.
Managed project improvements and presented findings to senior HR specialists.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Devised marketing and branding initiatives to promote agency as an employer of choice.
Facilitated information sessions on resume writing, USAJobs, and interview skills.
Developed and managed internship and student hiring programs, including Shadow Day and Paid Student Internship Program.
Created social media accounts and managed outreach to Gen X and Millennials.
Prepared presentations, handbooks, and mass communications for recruitment events.
Conducted research on applicant tracking systems and drafted SOPs for recruitment processes.
Coordinated with colleges and universities to expand student outreach and diversity recruitment.

experience.title: HR Assistant
responsibilities: Provided customer and technical support for delegated examining and staffing processes.
Drafted job analysis and announcements for Wage Grade and General Schedule positions.
Reviewed and pre‑audited delegated examining case files.
Advised senior HR specialists and hiring managers on policies and hiring flexibilities.

projects.name: Shadow Day Program
projects.description: Designed and implemented a program allowing students to shadow agency professionals, expanding outreach and recruitment.

projects.name: Onboarding Programs
projects.description: Developed onboarding, training, leadership development, and social media recruitment initiatives for supervisors and new employees.
